text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
A-And... it's doooone! Even I'm amazed by 
how much there is...! It's a whole 
mountain of truffles~ Phew~~~!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Still... Even after making this many, 
it's only two per person, huh."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Did I hand out too much...? No, but I 
really want to give them some. Even if 
it's just a little bit at a time..."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone's been taking such good care of 
me, so I really want to convey my 
gratitude to them..."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Something like this isn't too heavy and 
feels just right for you too... right, 
Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, right, right. Today's Valentine's 
Day, so... here, take this! I packed it 
with tons of whipped cream~.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wah, thanks! Is it handmade? I'm super 
happy~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: 'Mornin'! Ooh, smells super sweet~~.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, good morning! Help yourselves, 
everyone~ It's just a small token of my 
appreciation, though.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
“—This is for Valentine's... Thank you, as 
always. Let's keep training together and 
having fun, okay!”

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Same here~! Thank you so much, 
Dantsu-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
“—So that's why you were looking for me? 
Waah~! Thank you!”

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
“—No, not at all, it's just a small token. 
Senior, thank you so much for helping me 
out back then!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—One day, seeing Dantsu Flame together 
with an unfamiliar Umamusume reminded me 
of what day today was.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume E
text_block_list.text:
—You're giving me some too, Dantsu? 
Thanks! Man, what a haul today!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
W-Wow, you're popular as ever...! Fufufu, 
see you later then~.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Incredible. She really had a whole lot 
of chocolates.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Mine... Was it way too small after all...?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
No, it's the thought that counts! So it's 
fine... even like this.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I think we've handed out about half of 
them now. Let's see, next is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inside the paper bag were numerous neatly 
wrapped little packages. As I quietly 
admired how thoughtful and attentive she 
was...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh, Trainer? You're just in time!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Please take this if you'd like. It's a 
small token of my daily gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Um~, it's just a small token... but here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Making this whole batch, wrapping them 
up, walking around handing them out to 
each person, and properly conveying my 
gratitude with words..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And made with such meticulous care and 
thought, too. It must have been quite an 
effort... I shared my thoughts with her.
choice_data_list:
You worked so incredibly hard, didn't you, 
Dantsu!

You worked so incredibly hard, didn't you, 
Dantsu!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? No no, not at all...! Something 
like this is no big deal~... It's totally 
normal.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"There were even girls who put so much 
effort into making a big, magnificent 
batch of 'true feeling' chocolates!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: D-Do you think so...? I just...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Can I... believe that I actually did my 
best?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, Trainer, you... you always say things 
like that...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: "U-Um............ I'm sorry. Well..."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, could you spare a little time 
for me later!?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Um...! What should I makeeee?!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway, just that truffle isn't enough to 
show how grateful I am to Trainer...! I 
mean..."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I don't want to be... just one of many.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After school. Waiting in the trainer's 
room just as Dants Flame asked me to...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank you for waiting...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Um, well... Happy Valentine's Day!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Opening the box revealed a cup dessert 
inside. It looked like mousse topped with 
chunks of chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I'll borrow the microwave for a bit! To 
finish it off, pour the warm cream over it 
and~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she poured the warm cream... The 
chocolate melted, and a tart, fragrant 
berry sauce flowed out.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Here, please...! While it's still nice 
and gooey...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—It was an exceptionally delicious 
dish...! Which only made one ponder the 
sheer amount of time and effort she poured 
into it...
choice_data_list:
Don't tell me, this goes to everyone 
too...?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: That's simply impossible, even for me...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: So... that's not what happened...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
That's why I went with this. A special, 
separate one just for you, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Deep down... I was really happy, you know.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: He told me, "You worked so hard"... Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seemed unable to explain it well. 
However, the intricately crafted chocolate 
seemed to speak for a unique kind of 
gratitude...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Um, that story about my past from 
before... do you remember it?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I'm never in the spotlight... I'm just 
plain, and easily overlooked...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Still, Trainer, you tried to look closely 
at every part of me... even the parts that 
were hard to see...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"So, for people like that, 'special' 
chocolates are...!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
S-Something like that...! Was I being a 
bit too presumptuous?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
You're always so considerate, Trainer... 
Even earlier today, you were just casually 
trying to comfort me, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
How hard Dantsu Flame always works. The 
fiery passion she holds in her heart. 
Watching her by her side, I thought I 
understood it well.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...! No, no way...! Still, thank you 
very much...
choice_data_list: Look forward to your return gift!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Eeeh! N-No, it's fine! I'd feel bad!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Truly... as long as you could tell it was 
a little special, that was more than 
enough for me...!
